record_scope_reconstruction: Closure of cross-DMZ industrial access to the Kaesong factory zone, chiefly the western inter-Korean road corridor. Dorasan railway station, the factory zone centroid and individual gates are separate physical features.

source_checks.finding: Yonhap records South Koreans being ordered out of the industrial zone after Seoul suspended it.
Tenth-anniversary ministry account describes the complex still shuttered; no operational reopening is claimed.
Satellite analysis distinguishes the 4.7-km DMZ road section, southern post and northern checkpoint one kilometer beyond its gate; this warns against conflating road and Dorasan rail station.

date_scope_check.finding: Geography review only. Current phase bounds, traffic exceptions, uncertain onset, reopening status and >24-hour decision are retained; current map features are not evidence of historical operation.
date_scope_check.qualification: Ordinary cross-border industrial production access only. Diplomatic liaison-office work, facility inspection and invited businessmen's ceremonial visits at Kaesong in 2018 are excluded; they do not establish industrial reopening. The 11 February onset is the reported North Korean closure/expulsion, not a precisely observed final-exit time. No status after 10 February 2026 is inferred.
